questions.question: 20% of a number is 34. What is 50% of that number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

20% of a number is 34.

**Formula Used:**

Percentage formula: Part = (Percentage × Total) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ 20% of the number = 34

⇒ (20 × Number) ÷ 100 = 34

⇒ Number = (34 × 100) ÷ 20

⇒ Number = 170

⇒ 50% of the number = (50 × 170) ÷ 100

⇒ 50% of the number = 85

**∴ The correct answer is 85.**

questions.question: On selling 17 articles, a trader gains the cost price of 3 articles. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

On selling 17 articles, a trader gains the cost price of 3 articles.

**Formula Used:**

Profit Percentage = (Profit ÷ Cost Price) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the cost price of 1 article = ₹1

⇒ Cost price of 17 articles = 17 × ₹1 = ₹17

⇒ Selling price of 17 articles = Cost price of 17 articles + Profit

⇒ Profit = Cost price of 3 articles = 3 × ₹1 = ₹3

questions.question: A can complete a task in 10 days, while B can finish the same task in 12 days. They decide to work alternately, with A starting the work on the first day. How many days will it take for them to complete the entire task?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A = 10 days

B = 12 days

**Formula Used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Total Work = LCM of given times

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total Work = LCM of 10 and 12 = 60 units

⇒ Efficiency of A = 60 ÷ 10 = 6 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of B = 60 ÷ 12 = 5 units/day

⇒ Work done in 2 days (A + B) = 6 + 5 = 11 units

⇒ Work done in 10 days (5 cycles) = 11 × 5 = 55 units

⇒ Remaining Work = 60 − 55 = 5 units

⇒ Next turn is A

⇒ Time taken by A to complete 5 units = 5 ÷ 6 = 5/6 day

⇒ Total time = 10 + 5/6 = 10.83 days 

**∴ The correct answer is 10.83 days.**

questions.question: If a car reduces its speed by 10 km/h, it takes 1 hour more for a journey of 300 km. Find original speed.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 300 km

Decrease in speed = 10 km/h

Increase in time = 1 hour

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let original speed = x km/h

⇒ Time at original speed = 300 ÷ x

⇒ Time at reduced speed = 300 ÷ (x − 10)

⇒ 300 ÷ (x − 10) − 300 ÷ x = 1

⇒ 300x − 300(x − 10) ÷ x(x − 10) = 1

⇒ (300x − 300x + 3000) ÷ x(x − 10) = 1

⇒ 3000 ÷ x(x − 10) = 1

⇒ x(x − 10) = 3000

⇒ x² − 10x − 3000 = 0

⇒ x² − 60x + 50x − 3000 = 0

⇒ x(x − 60) + 50(x − 60) = 0

⇒ (x − 60)(x + 50) = 0

⇒ x = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60 km/h.**

questions.question: A sum becomes Rs. 6840 in 3 years at 9% simple interest per annum. What is the original sum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = 9% per annum, Time (T) = 3 years, Amount (A) = Rs. 6840

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

A = P + SI

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = (P × 9 × 3) ÷ 100 = (27P) ÷ 100

⇒ A = P + SI

⇒ 6840 = P + (27P ÷ 100)

⇒ 6840 = (100P + 27P) ÷ 100

⇒ 6840 = (127P) ÷ 100

⇒ P = (6840 × 100) ÷ 127

⇒ P = 5385.83

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 5385.83.**

questions.question: A tank shaped like a rectangular parallelepiped measures 2 m x 1.5 m x 1.2 m. How many liters of water can it hold?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct formula for **Volume** = **Length** × **Width** × **Height**

Volume in cubic meters = 2 × 1.5 × 1.2 = 3.6 m³

Conversion: **1 m³ = 1000 Liters**

Capacity = 3.6 × 1000 = 3600 L

**∴ The correct answer is 3600 L.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Length** (l) = 2 m

**Width** (w) = 1.5 m

**Height** (h) = 1.2 m

**Formula Used:**

**Volume** of a **Rectangular Parallelepiped** (Cuboid) = l × w × h

**Capacity** in liters = **Volume** in m³ × 1000

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0f7e5434d1580e851e652ae02cfbf8b44ca7ae4a21b9fd3d3be9cf6a196aacf.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = 2 × 1.5 × 1.2 m³

⇒ Volume = 3 × 1.2 m³

⇒ Volume = 3.6 m³

⇒ We know that 1 m³ = 1000 L

⇒ Capacity = 3.6 × 1000 L

⇒ Capacity = 3600 L

**∴ The correct answer is 3600 L.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Parallelepiped

The total area of all six faces is given by the formula: 2(lw + wh + hl).

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The longest rod that can be placed in the tank is the diagonal: d = √(l² + w² + h²).

Common Volume Conversions

1 Liter = 1000 cm³ and 1 m³ = 1,000,000 cm³ = 1000 Liters.

Volume of a Cube

If all sides are equal (a), the volume of a cube is a³.</p

questions.question: An artist carves an ice sculpture in shape of a right triangular pyramid (base triangle: base 6 cm, height 4 cm, pyramid height 9 cm). What is the volume of ice used?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Base Area of the **right triangular pyramid** = 1/2 × base × height = 1/2 × 6 × 4 = 12 cm².

Volume of any pyramid = 1/3 × Base Area × Pyramid Height.

Volume = 1/3 × 12 × 9 = 36 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 36 cm³.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Base of the triangular base (b) = 6 cm

Height of the triangular base (h) = 4 cm

Height of the **ice sculpture** (Pyramid Height, H) = 9 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of **Right Triangular Pyramid** = 1/3 × [Area of Triangular Base] × Height

Area of Triangle = 1/2 × base × height

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/105b2d2887a511a25f6cfb6024efe817a0068f4c3837f105eceae9e60b55cb1f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of the triangular base = 1/2 × 6 × 4

⇒ Area of the triangular base = 12 cm²

⇒ Volume of the **ice sculpture** = 1/3 × 12 × 9

⇒ Volume = 4 × 9

⇒ Volume = 36 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 36 cm³.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Pyramid

The volume of any pyramid is always 1/3 of the volume of a prism with the same base and height: V = 1/3 × Base Area × Height.

Total Surface Area of a Pyramid

Total Surface Area = Area of the Base + Sum of the areas of all lateral triangular faces.

Regular Tetrahedron

A special triangular pyramid where all four faces are equilateral triangles. Volume = a³/(6√2), where 'a' is the edge length.</p

questions.question: In triangle ABC, 'D' is a point on BC such that ∠BAD = ∠DAC. If AB = 24, AC = 16 and BC = 12.5, then find the length of BD.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AB = 24

AC = 16

BC = 12.5

**Formula Used:**

Angle bisector theorem: BD ÷ DC = AB ÷ AC

**Calculation:**

⇒ BD ÷ DC = 24 ÷ 16 = 3/2

⇒ Let BD = 3x and DC = 2x

⇒ BC = BD + DC = 3x + 2x = 5x

⇒ 5x = 12.5

⇒ x = 12.5 ÷ 5 = 2.5

⇒ BD = 3x = 3 × 2.5 = 7.5

**∴ The correct answer is 7.5.**

questions.question: Out of 200 students, 20%failed the exam. Out of the remaining 20% passed the exam with distinction. Find the ratio of the students who passed the exam with distinction to the students who passed the exam without distinction.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total students = 200

Failed = 20%

Distinction = 20% of remaining

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (part ÷ total) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Failed students = 20% of 200 = 40

⇒ Remaining students = 200 − 40 = 160

⇒ Students with distinction = 20% of 160 = 32

⇒ Students without distinction = 160 − 32 = 128

⇒ Required ratio = 32 : 128

⇒ Divide by 32 ⇒ 1 : 4

**∴ The correct answer is 1 : 4.**

Two right-angled triangles with hypotenuse and one side equal.

RHS (Right angle-Hypotenuse-Side) Congruence Rule.

**Calculation:**

⇒ The given condition satisfies the RHS Congruence Rule.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

questions.question: The ratio of the length and breadth of a rectangle is 6 : 5, respectively. It is made from a circular loop of a wire having a radius of 14 cm. Find the sum of the length of the rectangle and the diameter of the loop.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of length to breadth = 6:5

Radius of circular loop = 14 cm

**Formula Used:**

Circumference of circle = 2 × π × radius

Perimeter of rectangle = 2 × (length + breadth)

Length of rectangle = k × 6, Breadth of rectangle = k × 5 (where k is a common multiplier)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Circumference of circular loop = 2 × π × 14 = 88 cm

⇒ Perimeter of rectangle = Circumference of circular loop = 88 cm

⇒ 2 × (6k + 5k) = 88

⇒ 2 × 11k = 88

⇒ 22k = 88

⇒ k = 88 ÷ 22 = 4

⇒ Length of rectangle = 6k = 6 × 4 = 24 cm

⇒ Breadth of rectangle = 5k = 5 × 4 = 20 cm

⇒ Diameter of loop = 2 × radius = 2 × 14 = 28 cm

⇒ Sum of length of rectangle and diameter of loop = 24 + 28 = 52 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 52 cm.**

questions.question: A, B, and C invest in a business. A invests Rs 20,000, B invests Rs 25,000, and C invests Rs 30,000. What is the total profit if the share of B is Rs 5,000?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **investment** of **A** : **B** : **C** = 20,000 : 25,000 : 30,000 = 4 : 5 : 6

Total units of **profit** = 4 + 5 + 6 = 15 units

Given, **B**’s **profit share** (5 units) = ₹5,000

1 unit = ₹1,000

Total **profit** = 15 units × ₹1,000 = ₹15,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹15,000.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Investment of **A** = ₹20,000

Investment of **B** = ₹25,000

Investment of **C** = ₹30,000

Share of **B** in **profit** = ₹5,000

**Formula Used:**

In a **partnership**, **Profit Ratio** = Ratio of (Investment × Time)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb11a80482cf46aacfe011035e0152e3cd6231fb5a77002320417438df70e8bd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Profit Ratio (A : B : C) = 20,000 : 25,000 : 30,000

⇒ Profit Ratio = 4 : 5 : 6

⇒ Let the **profit shares** be 4x, 5x, and 6x respectively.

⇒ Given, **B**’s share = 5x = 5,000

⇒ x = 5,000 ÷ 5 = 1,000

⇒ Total **profit** = 4x + 5x + 6x = 15x

⇒ Total **profit** = 15 × 1,000 = 15,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹15,000.**

**__Additional Information__**

Ratio of Profits

In any partnership, the ratio of **profit** distribution is calculated as: P₁ : P₂ = (I₁ × T₁) : (I₂ × T₂), where I is **investment** and T is **time**.

Simple Partnership

When the **time period** for all investments is the same, the **profit** is shared simply in the ratio of the **capitals** invested.

Compound Partnership

When **partners** invest their capital for different **time periods**, the profit is shared in the ratio of the product of capital and time.

questions.question: Two runners, A and B, start from the same point on a circular track of 400 m. They run in the same direction with speeds of 10 m/s and 7 m/s, respectively. How many times will they cross each other in 15 minutes?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Track length = 400 m

Speed of A = 10 m/s

Speed of B = 7 m/s

Time = 15 minutes = 900 s

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed = Difference of speeds (same direction)

Number of crossings = (Relative speed × Time) ÷ Track length

**Calculation:**

⇒ Relative speed = 10 − 7 = 3 m/s

⇒ Distance covered relatively = 3 × 900 = 2700 m

⇒ Number of crossings = 2700 ÷ 400 = 6.75

⇒ Number of complete crossings = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

questions.question: The average marks of 40 students in a class is 72. Later, it was discovered that a student's marks were recorded as 93 instead of 39. What is the correct average?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of students = 40

Average marks = 72

Incorrect marks = 93

Correct marks = 39

**Formula Used:**

Correct total marks = Incorrect total marks - Incorrect marks + Correct marks

Correct average = Correct total marks ÷ Number of students

**Calculation:**

⇒ Incorrect total marks = 72 × 40 = 2880

⇒ Correct total marks = 2880 - 93 + 39 = 2826

⇒ Correct average = 2826 ÷ 40 = 70.65

**∴ The correct answer is 70.65.**

questions.question: In a company, the monthly salaries of a manager, supervisor, and worker are in the ratio 7 : 5 : 3. If the supervisor earns 25,000, what is the manager's salary?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratios of salaries = 7 : 5 : 3

Supervisor's salary = 25,000

**Formula Used:**

Manager's salary = (Manager's ratio ÷ Supervisor's ratio) × Supervisor's salary

**Calculation:**

⇒ Manager's salary = (7 ÷ 5) × 25,000

⇒ Manager's salary = 1.4 × 25,000

⇒ Manager's salary = 35,000

**∴ The correct answer is 35,000.**

questions.question: In a circle with center O, a tangent touches the circle at point T. A secant drawn from an external point P passes through the center O. The length of the tangent PT is 12 units, and the radius of the circle is 5 units. What is the distance from point P to the nearest point on the circle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

PT = 12

Radius = 5

**Formula Used:**

PT² = PO² − r²

Distance to nearest point = PO − r

**Calculation:**

⇒ 12² = PO² − 5²

⇒ 144 = PO² − 25

⇒ PO² = 169

⇒ PO = 13

⇒ Distance = 13 − 5 = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

questions.question: A regular polygon has an interior angle that is 5 times the measure of its exterior angle. How many sides does the polygon have?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a **regular polygon**, the ratio of the **interior angle** to the **exterior angle** is given as 5 : 1.

Since the sum of an **interior angle** and an **exterior angle** at any vertex is always 180°:

5 units + 1 unit = 6 units ⇒ 180°

1 unit (**Exterior Angle**) = 180° ÷ 6 = 30°

**Number of sides (n)** = 360° ÷ **Exterior Angle** = 360° ÷ 30° = 12.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 sides.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Interior angle** (I) = 5 × **Exterior angle** (E)

**Formula Used:**

1. **Interior Angle** + **Exterior Angle** = 180° (**Linear Pair** property)

2. Each **Exterior Angle** of a **regular polygon** = 360° ÷ n

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb203d393c4ab64858914c65ef85daf9d82c6e837ba8dccc39fae8505cf1c2b4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **exterior angle** be x.

⇒ Then the **interior angle** is 5x.

⇒ 5x + x = 180°

⇒ 6x = 180°

⇒ x = 180° ÷ 6 = 30°

⇒ Each **exterior angle** = 30°

⇒ n = 360° ÷ **Exterior angle**

⇒ n = 360° ÷ 30°

⇒ n = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 sides.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of all **interior angles** of a polygon with n sides is (n − 2) × 180°.

Sum of Exterior Angles

The sum of **exterior angles** of any convex polygon, regardless of the number of sides, is always 360°.

Regular Polygon Property

In a **regular polygon**, all sides and all angles (both interior and exterior) are equal.

Number of Diagonals

The number of **diagonals** in a polygon with n sides is given by the formula n(n − 3) ÷ 2.</p

questions.question: If 4x² + y² = 40 and xy = 6, find the value of 2x + y and 2x - y.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

4x² + y² = 40

xy = 6

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

**Calculation:**

⇒ (2x + y)² = 4x² + y² + 4xy

⇒ (2x + y)² = 40 + 4 × 6 = 40 + 24 = 64

⇒ 2x + y = 8

⇒ (2x − y)² = 4x² + y² − 4xy

⇒ (2x − y)² = 40 − 24 = 16

⇒ 2x − y = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 2x + y = 8 and 2x − y = 4.**

questions.question: If two circles intersect at two points, how many common tangents are possible if the circles have the same radius?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two circles intersect at two points

Both circles have same radius

**Formula Used:**

Number of common tangents depends on position of circles

**Calculation:**

⇒ When two circles intersect at two points, they overlap

⇒ In this case, only direct common tangents exist

⇒ Number of direct common tangents = 2

⇒ Transverse common tangents are not possible

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

questions.question: If sin 3A=(3)/(5), find the values of cos 3A and tan 3A.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sin3A = 3/5

**Formula Used:**

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

tanθ = sinθ ÷ cosθ

**Calculation:**

⇒ sin3A = 3/5 ⇒ cos3A = √(1 − (3/5)²)

⇒ cos3A = √(1 − 9/25) = √(16/25) = 4/5

⇒ tan3A = sin3A ÷ cos3A = (3/5) ÷ (4/5)

⇒ tan3A = 3/4

**∴ The correct answer is cos3A = 4/5 and tan3A = 3/4.**

questions.question: What sum will amount to Rs. 23958 in 3 years at the rate of 10 percent per annum at compound interest (cormpounding annually)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount = Rs. 23958

Rate = 10% per annum

Time = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest Formula: A = P × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

Where:

A = Final Amount

P = Principal

r = Rate of Interest

n = Time Period

**Calculation:**

⇒ 23958 = P × (1 + 10/100)³

⇒ 23958 = P × (1.1)³

⇒ 23958 = P × 1.331

⇒ P = 23958 ÷ 1.331

⇒ P = 18000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 18000.**

questions.question: Marked price of an article is 140 percent more than the value of discount. Selling price is what percent of the marked price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price = 140% more than Discount

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price − Discount

Percentage = (part ÷ whole) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Discount = 100

⇒ Marked Price = 100 + 140% of 100 = 100 + 140 = 240

⇒ Selling Price = 240 − 100 = 140

⇒ Required % = (140 ÷ 240) × 100

⇒ = 7/12 × 100 = 58.33%

**∴ The correct answer is 58.33%.**
